label: adult-s5
summary: The model predicts the chance that a person earns at most 50k a year (training AUC 0.9118). Its score is a constant plus parts that add on the logit. Most of the ranking comes from direct linear terms (switching them to their mean drops training AUC to 0.6464): capital gain, marriage to a civilian spouse, years of education, age, capital loss and male sex each lower the predicted chance. On top of these the model bends three inputs. Age: the predicted chance falls up to 46 years and then rises again, because a hinge more than cancels the direct age slope (on for 10779 training rows). Hours per week: shorter weeks raise the predicted chance, and past a knot between 49 hours and 50 hours more hours do not change it. Capital gain: two hinges above roughly 5000 US dollars make a large gain close to decisive (typical case 72% with no gain, 2% at 10000 US dollars), with country and 9th-grade exceptions fitted to 23 rows with large gains. Unincorporated self-employment adds a step that raises the predicted chance (3034 rows), and three steps on rare categories (Trinidad and Tobago, preschool education, Yugoslavia) are fitted to 22, 64 and 21 rows. Worth checking: because inputs are z-scored, rare one-hot levels get extreme scores; the 29 training rows married to an armed-forces spouse get a mean predicted chance of below 1% although 55.2% of them earn at most 50k.

The two needs_review items (income_model evidence[1] and evidence[2], stale ids q_9733314f3c and q_d6fa940645, computed before the splits and the identity node) are not errors: both queries were rerun after the last structural operation (q_435699ac39, q_fd3674b1b9) with identical values (AUC 0.9118 with, 0.8914 without; n 39073), the root hypothesis now cites the new id, and both records were amended with amend_evidence(query_id=...), which replaced the payload. amend_evidence does not update the record-level provenance list, so recheck still reads the old ids there (tool bug noted). The operations in between are function preserving (max error below 1e-15). 57 free-text sentences are unchecked by recheck; every number in them is a placeholder audited against get_query.
tool_bugs: None blocking. Notes: (1) probe input paths (rows[k].inputs.<var>) are strings with units, so a numeric format such as .0f is refused; quoted them unformatted. (2) query_ablate(where=...) reports the population's AUC in data.auc_with/auc_without, which is degenerate on small one-level subgroups (for example 1.0 on the preschool rows); only mean_risk_change was quoted from those. (3) The rename_inputs step counts as 107 operations, so a query run before the splits is flagged stale by recheck, as expected; two such queries were recomputed and the evidence amended. (4) amend_evidence(query_id=...) replaces the payload but leaves the record's provenance list on the old query id, so recheck keeps flagging a superseded stale query as needs_review.
